The following is an exhibit of flats and textures taken from SA-SRB2, an old SRB2 mod created by BlazeHedgehog to make SRB2's maps look and play more like the levels in the Sonic Adventure games. A few of the flats and textures were even taken from the Sonic Adventure games themselves.
